name: lens-retrieval-acceptance
provenance: Lens-authored synthetic activity and questions, written 2026-10-26 BEFORE answerability-verifier development; not user data.
policy: Sealed final acceptance holdout. Never used for tuning, calibration, threshold choice or error inspection. Runs only with --fixture acceptance --final; each run is logged in reports/retrieval-nl/holdout-runs.log.txt.
fields: memories: [id, language, app, timestamp, text]; queries: [id, language, type, query, relevant_ids]; empty relevant_ids = no valid answer. near_miss subtypes: entity (right person, fact absent), attribution (fact said by a different person), action (different action on the same object), specific (same topic, different specific)
